McpServerConfigIdentity.description: Identity of every selected user configuration layer that supplied effective MCP configuration, ordered from base to highest-precedence profile.

McpServerConfigIdentityLayer.description: One selected user configuration layer that contributes to effective MCP configuration.

filePath.description: Normalized absolute path spelling from the accepted selected user configuration snapshot. This deliberately does not resolve symlinks.

version.description: Existing canonical layer version, in `sha256:...` form.

description:
Paired MCP configuration identities for diagnostic comparison.

`applied` is every selected user configuration layer accepted by the running server's most recent successful startup or strict MCP reload. `current` is freshly read from every selected user configuration layer when this method runs.
title: McpServerConfigIdentityResponse
